title: The Latest Crier for Oct 29, 2026
items:
Disc Golf Intramurals

Disc Golf Sign-Ups Are Open! Join us for three weeks of friendly competition and fun on the course. 

Disc Golf Intramurals now offers flexible scheduling! Teams can play their weekly round on any day and time that works for them, as long as it takes place during the designated competition week. Participants must submit their tee time before playing and complete one round each week of the three-week competition. Rounds cannot be played ahead or combined into a single week 

Register today! Sign up here: Disc Golf Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form

CAB Positions Open!

The best campus events don't happen by accident. They're planned by students like you. CAB leadership positions are now open! If you're creative, organized, and want to make a difference at Central, apply today. Applications close: 11/06/26 

Apply here: https://recruiting.paylocity.com/recruiting/jobs/Apply/4614356/Central-College/Student-CAB-Generalist

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar!

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar! Join us for a Halloween party on Friday, October 30th from 9-11 pm in the BMW rooms (1st floor of Maytag). We'll have karaoke , a costume contest , snacks , and a cash bar for those 21 and older. Cash prizes will be awarded to the winners!
